summary:
Comprehensive visual branding update plan for Hala app:
- Extraction and setup of new app icon assets from `hala-icons-final` into `/public/icons/`
- Redesign of WelcomeScreen with emerald gradient (#087F75 to #04472B), subtle 8-point Islamic star geometric watermark, new high-res logo with <1s entrance animation, golden accent (#F5C451), and safe-area touch ergonomics
- Updating SplashScreen to match the deep emerald gradient and new brand logo
- Project-wide replacement of legacy logo references across index.html, PWA manifest in vite.config.ts, firebase-messaging-sw.js, notifications.ts, and UI screens
- Verification checklist ensuring zero logic alteration to calling, messaging, voice notes, auth, and state management.
